diagnostic_authority.numerical_status: DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE is permitted after successful structural checks; no numerical PASS/FAIL threshold is specified or permitted for residual agreement in this phase.
diagnostic_authority.physical_status: No accuracy, coefficient-generation, or broadband difference gate closes even if all point residuals are zero.
diagnostic_authority.purpose: Obtain a separately implemented point reconstruction from original held state and raw table, to locate loading/species/interpolation discrepancies. This is diagnostic evidence only.
diagnostic_authority.unresolved: A prior rigorous forward-error bound including all upstream weights, gas scaling, LOG implementations and discrete branch stability has not been established. Gamma_256 is not a valid strict gate and is withdrawn from this diagnostic phase.

held_state_and_density_contract.constant_source: Avogadro and dry molecular weight come from input/pinned constants. The previous independent pfrac run recomputed dry mass with this formula and found max relative difference 2.22e-16 to saved GAS_COL_DRY; that is context only, not a tolerance to fit.
held_state_and_density_contract.gas_column: Set col_gas(0)=recomputed col_dry and col_gas(g)=input VMR[g]*col_dry. Keep the four trace-gas profiles from input; do not infer any VMR from legacy WKL columns.
held_state_and_density_contract.input_format: RRTMGP_REPLAY_V10, LW, ncol=1, nlay=45. PLAY/PLEV text values are hPa and driver multiplies by 100 for Pa before gas_optics; TLAY is K. Input has NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2 width 45 and scalar MOL_WEIGHT_DRY, plus ten gas VMR sections (six main LW gases plus CFC11/12/22/CCl4).
held_state_and_density_contract.matched_profile_exception: This is the exact retained matched-legacy-dry diagnostic carrier: the original V10 trace had a 32-value mass section, and the pinned dry-column plan changed only NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2 to a 45-value section. The replay reader sets n_native from section width, so all 45 solver levels are overridden from supplied masses. The 32-native/13-upper-extension description is physical coordinate context, not the mass state represented by this matched input. Do not silently restore the original 32-value prefix/default upper mass; reconstruct the actual held 45-value carrier.
held_state_and_density_contract.n2_cases: Absent-N2 initializes the ten-gas list and filters N2 minor intervals. Explicit N2=0 initializes the 11-gas list, retains those intervals but gives them zero amount. The 0.7808 case uses the CLI N2 VMR override (not a V10 text section), retains intervals, and activates their scaled absorption. Keep these as separate roster cases.
held_state_and_density_contract.reconstruct_dry_column_first: Recompute each layer col_dry = NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2 * Avogadro / (MOL_WEIGHT_DRY * 10000), using all 45 held mass values and the pinned constants. Do not use saved GAS_COL_DRY as reconstruction input. Compare the independently computed result with saved GAS_COL_DRY only after reconstruction.

independent_reconstruction_steps: Authenticate every retained artifact plus current PR109 frontend/kernel/loader source identity; no solver/executable is executed.
Independently derive all 45 matched dry amounts and active VMR columns, retaining absent/zero N2 roster distinction.
Reduce available gas roster in coefficient-table order (frontend PACK), derive key pairs/flavors and interpolation context from held state/raw named dimensions.
Reconstruct all three point arrays and component ledgers with source-ordered major/minor equations; save the construction artifact before reading captured target optical depths.
Only then read authenticated target GAS_TAU_RAW/GAS_TAU and dry/context diagnostics; report raw residual/ULP statistics without any tolerance-based numerical verdict.

matched_carrier_provenance.physical_scope: The reconstructed dry column is for all 45 solver layers in this matched carrier. It does not reconstruct or establish accuracy of the normal 32 native dry-mass levels plus 13 extensions; the extension values are explicitly counterfactual carrier values.

Its source input has NATIVE_DRY_LAYER_MASS_KG_M2 width 32; the dry-carrier plan changes only that section to width 45, and the replay reader sets n_native from that width and replaces all 45 levels.

precision_and_gate_policy.before_any_calculation: Verify every pinned artifact and exact current/replay source identity; validate all finite values, shapes, units, band maps, gas roster, dimension order and pressure/temp ranges.
precision_and_gate_policy.comparison: No numerical PASS threshold. Raw binary64 residual/ULP data are diagnostic only. Structural source agreement and finite/shape controls are prerequisites, not physical accuracy.
precision_and_gate_policy.cross_engine: Only exact shared band edges; no gpoint pairing, no per-index comparisons, no inferred spectral accuracy, and no conversion of tau match into broadband accuracy claim.
precision_and_gate_policy.runtime_binding: Bind the actual executable, execution receipt, runtime coefficient path, and linked source/build receipts before using the captured GAS_TAU outputs as comparison targets.

purpose: Specify a separately implemented numerical reconstruction of the pinned RRTMGP LW GAS_TAU from the retained matched BON column and exact pinned LW k-distribution table. Do not rerun gas_optics, compile, or call an RTE/solver as the reconstruction.

raw_table_mapping_contract.gas_order: Caller membership is ten supplied species plus optional N2; runtime reduced roster is PACK(table gas_names, present in caller), not caller insertion order. Key/flavor and col_gas positive indexes use that table order, zero index is dry.
raw_table_mapping_contract.major_axes: Raw Python NetCDF kmajor axes (temperature, pressure_interp, mixing_fraction, gpt), shape (14,60,9,128). Python indexes [temp, pressure, eta, gpoint]. Loader Fortran input is (gpt,eta,pressure,temp); frontend RESHAPE ORDER=(4,2,3,1) produces kernel logical array (temp,eta,pressure,gpt). This corrects V2's misleading internal-axis label; no table bytes change.
raw_table_mapping_contract.major_path: For each band/layer choose lower/upper atmosphere key pair and runtime flavor. For each of two reference temperature planes form col_mix from major species columns and table vmr_ref ratio; interpolate kmajor in its four eta-pressure corners at each plane and apply col_mix for that plane. Lower vs upper pressure slots have the source-required one-index shift. Sum the major component by flavor and in total.
raw_table_mapping_contract.minor_path: For each interval use inclusive minor_limits_gpt, source kminor_start, and lower/upper pool. Base scaling is col_gas of minor absorber. If density flag is true, multiply by 0.01*PLAY(Pa)/TLAY(K); if a scaling gas is configured, apply source dry-fraction plus selected gas ratio or complement flag. Interpolate kminor over eta/temp (2×2 corners), multiply by scaling, and add into total tau.
raw_table_mapping_contract.minor_pool_and_packing: Raw kminor lower/upper pools use named axes `(temperature,mixing_fraction,contributors_*)`, 485 and 308 contributor rows. Map each interval `minor_gases_*`→`identifier_minor`→`gas_minor`, then include only intervals whose parent gas is available. For removed intervals, runtime packed kminor_start subtracts the cumulative g-point widths of eliminated preceding intervals; independently either reproduce this packed layout or address original uncompressed pool by original start and prove identical source-row selection.
raw_table_mapping_contract.pfrac_equations_context: Pinned pfrac design/analyzer gives equations and checked mappings for reduced key_species, flavor order, jtemp/jpress, ftemp/fpress, atmosphere, eta and fmajor-like corner weights. Recompute these from input/table in the independent opacity path; use pfrac result only as a cross-check of derived bracket/weight metadata.
raw_table_mapping_contract.rayleigh: Pinned LW table contains no rayl_lower/rayl_upper arrays, so this is gas absorption only; do not add Rayleigh.

remaining_inputs.external_truth: Independent spectroscopic coefficients/generator or alternative gas k table are not present; therefore this check cannot adjudicate absolute physical opacity accuracy or uniquely split the legacy-vs-GP flux residual.
remaining_inputs.legacy_comparison: Legacy TAUGAS/WKL values are retained. No one-to-one legacy↔GP g-point pairing exists; only exact common-band summaries are admissible.
remaining_inputs.primary_gp_reconstruction: No essential numerical inputs appear missing: held V10 state/mass/VMRs, exact LW gas k table and metadata, compiled/replay provenance, and saved GP gas optical-depth outputs are all retained.

reporting_policy.cross_engine: Defer legacy band-distribution summaries to a separate reviewed analysis. Never pair 128 and 140 g-point indices.
reporting_policy.dry_context: Recompute dry amounts from all 45 supplied matched-carrier masses. Captured GAS_COL_DRY and previous pfrac discrete state are post-reconstruction cross-checks only; not inputs to tau.
reporting_policy.failure: Structural/source-index/check failures stop with retained failure artifacts; fix in a new version. They cannot be reclassified as production port bugs without separate evidence.
reporting_policy.primary: All 45x128 cells for each of absent N2, explicit zero N2, and N2=0.7808. Construct and freeze all three independent arrays before opening any captured GAS_TAU target.
reporting_policy.raw_statistics: Save signed/absolute/relative residual arrays, max and RMS, signed ordered-binary64 ULP differences, along with exact target pins. Relative residual at zero target must be explicitly undefined or separately classified; never add a fitted floor.
reporting_policy.term_ledger: Save all eight weighted major corners, two plane column mixes and sums, resulting major contribution, each retained minor interval's four weighted corners, scaling factor, contribution and source raw/packed row map. Save pressure/temp/eta brackets, weights, gas-name roster, flavors and atmosphere masks.

scope.bands: Primary same-engine 45x128 diagnostic reconstruction only. Cross-engine band summaries deferred; gpoint pairing prohibited.
scope.column: BON nighttime d01 i13 j46 step721, 45 solver-coordinate levels. The held matched diagnostic dry-mass carrier supplies ALL 45 values; it is not a fresh reconstruction of native32 plus default13-extension mass.
scope.gas_tau_artifacts: GP result sections GAS_TAU and GAS_TAU_RAW have shape (1,45,128); the retained legacy packet TAUGAS has shape (140,45). Both are available, but gpoint indices are engine-specific and must never be paired.
scope.not_claimed: A reconstruction from the same coefficient file checks table loading, species mapping and interpolation implementation against captured GP tau; it is not an independent coefficient-generation or physical-accuracy oracle and does not uniquely attribute the cross-engine flux residual.
scope.not_repeated: The earlier independent Planck/source mapping is pinned for state/provenance context, but this plan does not recalculate Planck source, angular transport, or prior flux residual decomposition.
scope.pfrac_context: The pinned independent pfrac analyzer already reconstructs key-species/flavor mapping and jtemp/jpress/eta/fmajor interpolation context for this state. Pin it as equation/context and optional cross-check only; the opacity reconstruction must derive gas columns and interpolation from the original input and raw coefficients independently, not treat saved pfrac outputs as its tau oracle.
scope.target: Per-cell GP GAS_TAU/GAS_TAU_RAW (45 layers × 128 g-points) for the retained absent-N2, explicit-zero-N2, and 0.7808-N2 diagnostic outputs.
